Doctor, good morning. Please have a seat. What is your name and age? Patient, good morning, doctor. My name is Sunil Das. I am 58 years old. Doctor, tell me, what problem are you facing? Patient. Doctor, for the last three months my left eye feels heavy and sometimes I see rainbow-colored rings around lights at night. Doctor, any headache or vomiting with it?
Patient, mild headache in the evening but no vomiting. Doctor, do you have diabetes, blood pressure or asthma? Patient, I have blood pressure for five years. I take amlodipine, no sugar, asthma nahi hai. Doctor, does anyone in your family have glaucoma? Patient, yes, my mother had glaucoma. Doctor, okay, your vision is six-ninths in the right eye and six-twelfths in the left eye.
Patient, is it serious, doctor? Doctor, it can be controlled with drops. Start latanoprost 0.005% eyedrops.
One drop at bedtime in the left eye every day. Also, timolol 0.5% eyedrops. One drop twice a day in the left eye. Doctor, for the dryness, use carboxymethyl cellulose eyedrops four times a day in both eyes for one month. Doctor, we will do a visual field test, HFA 24-2, and an OCTR-NFL scan before your next visit.
Check the inner corner of the eye for two minutes. Keep a five-minute gap between two different eyedrops. These drops are lifelong. Do not stop them on your own. Doctor, come back after one month to check the pressure. Your children should also get their eyes checked for glaucoma. Patient, thank you, doctor.
